newsitem.title: USA: Son charged with killing parents in New Jersey.
newsitem.headline: Son charged with killing parents in New Jersey.

text.p: A Las Vegas computer scientist was charged with murder in the brutal stabbing of his parents, a couple devoted to psychiatry and the care of troubled children, officials said Tuesday.

Police, responding to an emergency call from a family friend, found the bodies of retired psychiatrist De Witt Crandell, 66, and his social worker wife Marion, 63, in their posh Englewood, New Jersey, home Monday morning.
Bergen County prosecutor Charles Buckley said 30-year-old De Witt Crandell Jr. was accused of two counts of murder and was being held in the county jail awaiting arraignment.
Buckley said there were signs of a struggle, but not of a forced entry into the house. The son fled the scene and was found in a nearby wooded area two hours later by police.
Authorities said De Witt Crandell, Jr, lived in Las Vegas, Nevada, and that the couple also had a daughter Jeannette, 24, who lived with her parents but was in Florida at the time of the killings.
